blocks.text: Ikki to'ldiruvchili fe'llar: kim ega bo'ladi?

give, offer, send, show, lend, pay, promise, teach, tell, ask kabi fe'llar ikki to'ldiruvchi oladi: odam va narsa (They gave **Madina** **a prize**; → qizil kitob, 96-dars). Bunday gapdan ikki xil majhul gap yasash mumkin: odam ega bo'ladi (Madina **was given** a prize) yoki narsa ega bo'ladi (A prize **was given to** Madina). Ingliz tilida **birinchisi ko'proq ishlatiladi**, chunki gap ko'pincha odam haqida bo'ladi.

rows: The garden **was shown to** the guests.

blocks.text: O'zbekcha uchun bu qolip g'ayrioddiy: bizda odam **jo'nalish kelishigida** qoladi — «**Menga** ish taklif qilishdi», «**Unga** sovrin berildi». Inglizchada esa aynan shu odam gap boshiga chiqib, **ega** bo'ladi: **I** was offered a job, **She** was given a prize. «To me was offered» yoki «Me was given» deb bo'lmaydi.

items.text: Nilufar **was offered** a place at three universities.
items.translation: Nilufarga uchta universitetdan o'qish joyi **taklif qilindi**.

items.text: We **were shown** the way by a kind old man.
items.translation: Bizga yo'lni mehribon bir chol **ko'rsatib qo'ydi**.

items.text: I **was lent** some money by a friend until payday.
items.translation: Maosh kunigacha bir do'stim menga qarzga pul **berib turdi**.

blocks.text: **explain, describe, suggest, report, introduce, mention, say** — bu fe'llarda odam faqat **to** bilan keladi va majhul gapda ega bo'la olmaydi: The rules **were explained to** me. ✓ — «I was explained the rules» ✗. The problem **was reported to** the manager. ✓
I was told to ..., we were asked to ...

tell, ask, advise, warn, remind, teach fe'llari «kimgadir biror ish qilishni» ma'nosida **somebody + to ...** qolipida keladi (→ qizil kitob, 53-dars; batafsil → 55-dars). Majhul nisbatda odam ega bo'ladi: I **was told to** wait, Passengers **are asked to** stay in their seats. Rasmiy e'lonlar, ish va xizmat ko'rsatish sohasida bu qolip juda ko'p uchraydi, chunki kim aytgani muhim emas — nima aytilgani muhim.

items.text: We **were asked to** switch off our phones during the ceremony.
Bekzod **was told** that the interview had been moved to Monday.
Guests **are reminded to** leave their keys at reception.

blocks.text: I was born — faqat majhul shaklda

O'zbekchada «tug'ilmoq» oddiy o'timsiz fe'l, inglizchada esa u doim majhul shaklda: **be born**. Odamning tug'ilishi o'tmishdagi voqea, shuning uchun deyarli doim **was / were born**: I **was born** in 1999, Where **were** you **born**? «I born» yoki «I am born» — xato. Present Simple (**are born**) faqat umumiy fakt uchun: Most babies **are born** in hospital.

items.text: My father **was born** in a village near Khiva.
When **were** you **born**? — On the third of May, 2001.
About two hundred babies **are born** in this hospital every month.
items.translation: Bu shifoxonada har oy ikki yuzga yaqin chaqaloq **tug'iladi**.

blocks.text: get + V3 — o'zgarish va kutilmagan voqea

So'zlashuvda **be** o'rniga ko'pincha **get** ishlatiladi: My phone **got stolen**, He **got hurt**, I **get paid** on Fridays. **get** majhuli harakatni, **o'zgarishni**, ko'pincha kutilmagan yoki noxush voqeani bildiradi; o'zbekchadagi «**-ib qoldi**», «**-ib ketdi**» ga yaqin: We **got lost** — **Adashib qoldik**. Rejalashtirilgan, rasmiy jarayon uchun get ishlatilmaydi: The palace **was built** in 1880 (got built ✗). Bundan tashqari, get + V3 turg'un iboralari bor: **get married**, **get divorced**, **get engaged**, **get dressed**, **get changed**, **get lost**, **get stuck**, **get involved**.

items.text: Kate and Tom **got engaged** on holiday in Scotland.
items.translation: Keyt va Tom Shotlandiyada dam olayotganda **unashtirildi**.

items.text: Several cars **got damaged** when the tree fell.
items.translation: Daraxt qulaganda bir nechta mashina **shikastlanib qoldi**.

items.text: **Did** you **get invited** to the opening of the new gallery?

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I born in Samarkand» / «I am born ...» → I **was born** in Samarkand; «Where are you born?» → Where **were** you **born**?; «To me was given a present» → I **was given** a present; «I was explained the task» → The task **was explained to** me; «He married with Madina» → He **married** Madina / He **got married to** Madina (with ✗); get majhulida so'roq do / did bilan: «Was he got hurt?» → **Did** he **get hurt**?

O'zbekcha gapda «**menga / unga / bizga**» + majhul fe'l («Menga aytishdi», «Unga sovg'a berildi») bo'lsa, inglizchada shu odamni ega qiling: **I was told**, **He was given** a present. «-ib qoldi» (adashib qoldik, tiqilib qoldi) ko'rsangiz — **get** + V3 ni eslang.

rows: explain / describe / suggest — faqat to bilan
tell / ask somebody to → was told to
get + V3 — so'zlashuv, o'zgarish, kutilmagan voqea

examples.title: **I was offered** / **She was given**: person as subject
examples.description: Ikki to'ldiruvchili fe'llarda odam majhul gapning egasi bo'ladi. O'zbekchada esa u jo'nalish kelishigida qoladi: «menga taklif qilishdi».

sentences.text: Aziz **was offered** a job in Dubai, but he decided to stay in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Azizga Dubayda ish **taklif qilindi**, lekin u Toshkentda qolishga qaror qildi.

sentences.text: Each participant **was handed** a name badge at the entrance.
sentences.translation: Kirishda har bir ishtirokchiga ism yozilgan nishon **berildi**.

sentences.text: We **were promised** a sea view, but our room looked onto a car park.
sentences.translation: Bizga dengiz manzarasi **va'da qilingan edi**, lekin xonamiz avtoturargohga qaragan edi.

sentences.text: **Were** you **sent** the new timetable, or should I forward it to you?
sentences.translation: Sizga yangi jadval **yuborildimi** yoki uni sizga jo'natib qo'yaymi?

sentences.text: Madina **has been awarded** a scholarship to study medicine in London.
sentences.translation: Madinaga Londonda tibbiyot o'qishi uchun stipendiya **ajratildi**.

sentences.text: Every new employee **is lent** a laptop for their first year at the company.
sentences.translation: Har bir yangi xodimga kompaniyadagi birinchi yili uchun noutbuk **vaqtincha beriladi**.

sentences.text: After the operation, my father **was given** strict advice about what he could eat.
sentences.translation: Operatsiyadan keyin otamga nima yeyish mumkinligi haqida qat'iy maslahat **berildi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **wasn't shown** the final version of the contract before she signed it.
sentences.translation: Imzolashdan oldin Nilufarga shartnomaning yakuniy varianti **ko'rsatilmagan**.

sentences.text: How much **were** you **offered** for your old car? — Less than I expected.
sentences.translation: Eski mashinangiz uchun sizga qancha **taklif qilishdi**? — Kutganimdan kamroq.

sentences.text: Instead of a pay rise, the staff **were given** two extra days of holiday.
sentences.translation: Maosh oshirish o'rniga xodimlarga qo'shimcha ikki kunlik ta'til **berildi**.

examples.title: **was told** / **was asked** (to ...)
examples.description: tell, ask, teach, show, remind, warn — majhul gapda odam ega bo'ladi, keyin to + fe'l yoki that / how bilan davom etadi.

sentences.text: We **were told** to wait in the corridor until our names were called.
sentences.translation: Bizga ismimiz chaqirilguncha yo'lakda kutib turishni **aytishdi**.

sentences.text: All passengers **were asked** to show their passports again at the gate.
sentences.translation: Barcha yo'lovchilardan chiqish eshigi oldida pasportlarini yana ko'rsatish **so'raldi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **was taught** to swim by her older brother when she was five.
sentences.translation: Sarani besh yoshligida akasi suzishga **o'rgatgan**.

sentences.text: I **was shown** how to use the new software on my first day.
sentences.translation: Birinchi ish kunimda menga yangi dasturdan qanday foydalanishni **ko'rsatishdi**.

sentences.text: **Were** you **told** why the train was late? — No, there was no announcement.
sentences.translation: Poyezd nega kechikkani sizga **aytildimi**? — Yo'q, hech qanday e'lon bo'lmadi.

sentences.text: Jasur **was warned** not to park there, but he didn't listen.
sentences.translation: Jasurni u yerga mashina qo'ymaslik haqida **ogohlantirishgan edi**, lekin u quloq solmadi.

sentences.text: Visitors **are asked** not to feed the animals in the zoo.
sentences.translation: Hayvonot bog'ida tashrifchilardan hayvonlarga ovqat bermaslik **so'raladi**.

sentences.text: Nobody **was told** that the office would be closed on Monday.
sentences.translation: Ofis dushanba kuni yopiq bo'lishi hech kimga **aytilmagan edi**.

sentences.text: Oliver **was asked** a lot of difficult questions at his job interview.
sentences.translation: Ish suhbatida Oliverga juda ko'p qiyin savollar **berildi**.

sentences.text: The students **were reminded** that phones aren't allowed in the exam hall.
sentences.translation: Talabalarga imtihon zaliga telefon olib kirish mumkin emasligi **eslatildi**.

examples.title: Thing as subject: **was given to**, **was explained to**
examples.description: Narsa ega bo'lsa, odam to bilan keladi. explain, describe, suggest, report, introduce fe'llarida odam faqat to bilan — «I was explained» bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: The first prize **was given to** a girl from a small village near Namangan.
sentences.translation: Birinchi sovrin Namangan yaqinidagi kichik qishloqlik qizga **berildi**.

sentences.text: Before we started, the rules of the game **were explained to** us.
sentences.translation: Boshlashdan oldin bizga o'yin qoidalari **tushuntirildi**.

sentences.text: These flowers **were sent to** Emma by a secret admirer.
sentences.translation: Bu gullarni Emmaga yashirin muxlisi **yuborgan**.

sentences.text: Our business plan **was described to** the investors in great detail.
sentences.translation: Biznes rejamiz investorlarga juda batafsil **tasvirlab berildi**.

sentences.text: A new date **was suggested to** the client, but she didn't reply.
sentences.translation: Mijozga yangi sana **taklif qilindi**, lekin u javob bermadi.

sentences.text: How much money **was lent to** the company by the bank?
sentences.translation: Bank kompaniyaga qancha pul **qarzga bergan**?

sentences.text: Yesterday the problem **was reported to** the manager, but nothing has been done yet.
sentences.translation: Kecha muammo haqida menejerga **xabar berildi**, lekin hali hech narsa qilinmadi.

sentences.text: The new teacher **was introduced to** the class on the first day of term.
sentences.translation: Yangi o'qituvchi chorakning birinchi kuni sinfga **tanishtirildi**.

sentences.text: This watch **was given to** my grandfather when he retired from the railway.
sentences.translation: Bu soat bobomga temir yo'ldan nafaqaga chiqqanida **sovg'a qilingan**.

sentences.text: Why **wasn't** this information **passed on to** the parents earlier?
sentences.translation: Nega bu ma'lumot ota-onalarga oldinroq **yetkazilmadi**?

examples.title: **was born** / **were born**
examples.description: be born — doim majhul: odam haqida was / were born, umumiy fakt uchun are born. «I born» yoki «I am born» deyilmaydi.

sentences.text: I **was born** in a small town near Fergana, but my family moved to Tashkent when I was three.
sentences.translation: Men Farg'ona yaqinidagi kichik shaharchada **tug'ilganman**, lekin uch yoshligimda oilam Toshkentga ko'chib kelgan.

sentences.text: Where **were** your parents **born**? — Both of them in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiz qayerda **tug'ilgan**? — Ikkalasi ham Buxoroda.

sentences.text: Kate's twins **were born** two months early, but they're both healthy now.
sentences.translation: Keytning egizaklari ikki oy erta **tug'ilgan**, lekin hozir ikkalasi ham sog'lom.

sentences.text: Nearly a million babies **are born** in Uzbekistan every year.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonda har yili millionga yaqin chaqaloq **tug'iladi**.

sentences.text: My grandmother **was born** in the same year that the war ended.
sentences.translation: Buvim urush tugagan yili **tug'ilgan**.

sentences.text: **Was** Oliver **born** in Oxford? — No, in a small town nearby.
sentences.translation: Oliver Oksfordda **tug'ilganmi**? — Yo'q, yaqinidagi kichik shaharchada.

sentences.text: Their first child **was born** on the night of the New Year celebrations.
sentences.translation: Ularning birinchi farzandi Yangi yil bayrami kechasi **dunyoga keldi**.

sentences.text: Nobody in the family knows exactly what year our great-grandfather **was born**.
sentences.translation: Oilada hech kim katta bobomizning qaysi yili **tug'ilganini** aniq bilmaydi.

sentences.text: Many great ideas **are born** out of simple mistakes.
sentences.translation: Ko'p buyuk g'oyalar oddiy xatolardan **tug'iladi**.

sentences.text: Although Sarah **was born** in Manchester, she has lived in Samarkand for ten years.
sentences.translation: Sara Manchesterda **tug'ilgan** bo'lsa-da, o'n yildan beri Samarqandda yashaydi.

examples.title: **get married**, **get dressed**, **get lost**
examples.description: get + V3 turg'un iboralari: turmush qurish, kiyinish, adashib qolish, tiqilib qolish. O'zbekchada ko'pincha bitta fe'l yoki «-ib qoldi».

sentences.text: Bekzod and Nilufar **got married** last summer in a big restaurant in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Bekzod va Nilufar o'tgan yozda Toshkentdagi katta restoranda **turmush qurishdi**.

sentences.text: Hurry up and **get dressed** — the taxi will be here in five minutes!
sentences.translation: Tezroq **kiyin** — taksi besh daqiqada keladi!

sentences.text: We **got lost** in the old streets of Bukhara and had to ask for directions.
sentences.translation: Buxoroning eski ko'chalarida **adashib qoldik** va yo'l so'rashga majbur bo'ldik.

sentences.text: James and his wife **got divorced** after fifteen years together.
sentences.translation: Jeyms va uning rafiqasi o'n besh yil birga yashagach **ajrashishdi**.

sentences.text: The lift **got stuck** between two floors, and we waited inside for an hour.
sentences.translation: Lift ikki qavat orasida **tiqilib qoldi** va biz ichida bir soat kutdik.

sentences.text: When did your sister **get engaged**? — Last week, and the wedding is in May.
sentences.translation: Opangiz qachon **unashtirildi**? — O'tgan hafta, to'y esa mayda.

sentences.text: I don't want to **get involved** in their argument — it's not my business.
sentences.translation: Ularning janjaliga **aralashishni** xohlamayman — bu mening ishim emas.

sentences.text: Give me two minutes to **get changed**, and then we can go to the gym.
sentences.translation: **Kiyimimni almashtirishga** ikki daqiqa bering, keyin sport zaliga boramiz.

sentences.text: Madina **got promoted** to head of department after only two years.
sentences.translation: Madina bor-yo'g'i ikki yildan keyin bo'lim boshlig'i lavozimiga **ko'tarildi**.

sentences.text: If you don't keep your desk tidy, important papers **get mixed up** very easily.
sentences.translation: Stolingizni tartibli saqlamasangiz, muhim qog'ozlar juda oson **aralashib ketadi**.

examples.title: **get hurt**, **got stolen**, **got caught**
examples.description: get + V3 — so'zlashuvda kutilmagan, ko'pincha noxush voqea. Inkor va so'roq do / did bilan yasaladi.

sentences.text: Be careful on that ladder — you could easily **get hurt**.
sentences.translation: O'sha narvonda ehtiyot bo'l — osongina **jarohatlanib qolishing** mumkin.

sentences.text: Tom's bike **got stolen** while he was having lunch in a café.
sentences.translation: Tom kafeda tushlik qilayotganida velosipedi **o'g'irlanib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Two boys **got caught** cheating in the maths exam yesterday.
sentences.translation: Kecha matematika imtihonida ikki bola ko'chirayotganda **qo'lga tushdi**.

sentences.text: How often do you **get paid** — every week or once a month?
sentences.translation: Sizga qanchalik tez-tez **maosh berishadi** — har hafta yoki oyda bir marta?

sentences.text: Several players **got injured** during the first half of the match.
sentences.translation: O'yinning birinchi bo'limida bir nechta o'yinchi **jarohat oldi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **got sacked** for coming to work late almost every day.
sentences.translation: Aziz deyarli har kuni ishga kech kelgani uchun **ishdan haydaldi**.

sentences.text: Some of our plates **got broken** when we moved to a new flat.
sentences.translation: Yangi kvartiraga ko'chganimizda tarelkalarimizning bir qismi **sinib ketdi**.

sentences.text: **Did** you **get invited** to Kate's party, or was it only for her colleagues?
sentences.translation: Keytning ziyofatiga **taklif qilindingmi** yoki u faqat hamkasblari uchunmidi?

sentences.text: I nearly **got knocked down** by a car while I was crossing the road.
sentences.translation: Yo'ldan o'tayotganimda meni mashina **urib ketishiga** sal qoldi.

sentences.text: Fortunately, nothing **got damaged** when the heavy shelf fell down.
sentences.translation: Baxtimizga, og'ir javon qulaganda hech narsa **shikastlanmadi**.

examples.title: **be** or **get**? **was built** / **got broken**
examples.description: be + V3 — rasmiy uslub, holat yoki rejalashtirilgan ish; get + V3 — so'zlashuv, o'zgarish, kutilmagan voqea. Bir gapda ikkalasi.

sentences.text: My cousin **is married** to a doctor — they **got married** in Samarkand three years ago.
sentences.translation: Amakivachcham shifokorga **turmushga chiqqan** — ular uch yil oldin Samarqandda **turmush qurishgan**.

sentences.text: The agreement **was signed** by both presidents during the official visit.
sentences.translation: Kelishuv rasmiy tashrif chog'ida ikkala prezident tomonidan **imzolandi**.

sentences.text: I left my umbrella on the bus, and of course it **got taken**.
sentences.translation: Soyabonimni avtobusda qoldirgan edim, tabiiyki, uni kimdir **olib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Hundreds of letters **are delivered** here each day, but some **get lost** on the way.
sentences.translation: Bu yerga har kuni yuzlab xat **yetkaziladi**, lekin ba'zilari yo'lda **yo'qolib qoladi**.

sentences.text: **Did** your car **get damaged** in the storm last night?
sentences.translation: Kechagi bo'ronda mashinangiz **shikastlandimi**?

sentences.text: The winners **will be announced** on Friday, and I really hope I **get chosen**.
sentences.translation: G'oliblar juma kuni **e'lon qilinadi**, men **tanlanishimga** juda umid qilyapman.

sentences.text: Sorry I'm late — I **got held up** at the bank for almost an hour.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, kechikdim — bankda qariyb bir soat **ushlanib qoldim**.

sentences.text: Emma **was invited** to give a talk at the conference — a real honour for a young scientist.
sentences.translation: Emma konferensiyada ma'ruza qilishga **taklif qilindi** — yosh olim uchun katta sharaf.

sentences.text: Although the building **was badly damaged** by the fire, nobody **got hurt**.
sentences.translation: Bino yong'indan jiddiy **shikastlangan** bo'lsa-da, hech kim **jarohat olmadi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **gets paid** on the first of the month, so he's always broke by the end.
sentences.translation: Jasur oyning birinchi kuni **maosh oladi**, shuning uchun oy oxiriga borib doim puli qolmaydi.

examples.title: Dialogue: news from an old friend
examples.description: Ikki eski do'st uchrashib, yangiliklarni aytishadi: got married, was born, was offered, got promoted — darsning barcha shakllari suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Oliver! I haven't seen you for ages. Is it true that you **got married**?
sentences.translation: — Oliver! Seni ko'rmaganimga ancha bo'ldi. **Uylanganing** rostmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, last spring! And our daughter **was born** in January, so life is busy.
sentences.translation: — Ha, o'tgan bahorda! Qizimiz esa yanvarda **tug'ildi**, shuning uchun hayot qaynoq.

sentences.text: — Congratulations! Are you still at the bank, or **were** you **offered** something better?
sentences.translation: — Tabriklayman! Hali ham bankdamisan yoki senga yaxshiroq narsa **taklif qilishdimi**?

sentences.text: — Actually, I **got promoted**, so now I'm managing the Manchester branch.
sentences.translation: — Aslida, **lavozimim ko'tarildi**, endi Manchester filialini boshqaryapman.

sentences.text: — That's brilliant news. **Were** you **given** a company car too?
sentences.translation: — Bu zo'r yangilik. Senga xizmat mashinasi ham **berildimi**?

sentences.text: — No, but I **was promised** one next year if the branch does well.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, lekin filial yaxshi ishlasa, kelasi yil berishga **va'da qilishdi**.

sentences.text: — Lucky you! I **got made redundant** in March when my company closed.
sentences.translation: — Omading kelibdi! Men esa martda kompaniyam yopilganda **ishsiz qoldim**.

sentences.text: — Oh no, I'm sorry. **Did** you **get paid** anything when it closed?
sentences.translation: — Voy, achinarli. Yopilganda senga biror pul **to'lashdimi**?

sentences.text: — A little. But I**'ve** just **been offered** a job in Edinburgh, so I'm fine.
sentences.translation: — Ozgina. Lekin hozirgina menga Edinburgda ish **taklif qilishdi**, shuning uchun hammasi joyida.

sentences.text: — Great! Let's meet before you go, but don't **get lost** on the way this time!
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib! Ketishingdan oldin uchrashaylik, faqat bu safar yo'lda **adashib qolma**!
